title: Slideshow/Staff layout: PageLayout wrapping persists despite skipInheritedLayouts
description:
Both /slideshows/* and /staff/* routes show the public PageLayout (PageHeader/PageFooter) despite:
- app.layout('/slideshows/*', SlideshowLayout, { skipAppWrapper: true, skipInheritedLayouts: true })
- app.layout('/staff/*', StaffLayout, { skipAppWrapper: true, skipInheritedLayouts: true })
- Confirmed PageLayout registered as app.layout('*', PageLayout, { showHero: false })

Suspicion: skipInheritedLayouts may not work as expected with the wildcard '*' registration, or the option name/API has changed in this version of Fresh v2.

Investigate:
1. Check Fresh v2 (@fresh/core ^2.2.0) changelog/docs for correct API to exclude routes from a layout
2. Check if file-based _layout.tsx approach (routes/staff/_layout.tsx, routes/slideshows/_layout.tsx) works independently of main.ts app.layout()
3. Consider moving PageLayout out of app.layout('*') and into individual route groups instead
4. SlideshowLayout lives at site/components/SlideshowLayout.tsx
5. StaffLayout lives at site/components/StaffLayout.tsx

title: Consolidate content data directories under site/data/
description:
Move content data to a consistent location under site/data/:

- site/events/ (yaml) → site/data/events/

site/data/slideshows/ already planned as new home for slideshow data.
site/data/resources/ already in place.

Run deno task check to confirm no breakage.

title: Slideshow system: auth/login for presenter access
description:
Presenters must authenticate to access the controller actor and speaker notes views. Attendees connect as public receivers (no auth required for initial version).

Scope:
- Login/session system for /slideshows/[slug]/controller and /slideshows/[slug]/speaker routes
- Controller actor role requires authenticated presenter session
- Public receiver role (/slideshows/[slug]) remains open
- Consider PIN-based room access as lightweight alternative to full login
- Integrates with wider site auth if/when that exists

title: issues search should include issue ID
Provide option for user to auto-register for all events
description:
This is a request from a user and needs to be thought through. As described, auto-register could result in events having hundreds of registrations, and no available slots for new registration.

So we don’t want to actually register user for every events. I think it’s worth considering what the real reason for user request was. He didn’t get a notification about the event beforehand … because he wasn’t registered. 

That means the user really wants a “notification” for all events, including “event is happening soon”. But there needs to be an educational component, the user still needs to register for the event, not just attend without notice. 

Help CNG discuss options to solve the actual user requirements, and then plan a solution.

title: Blog hero image: support frontmatter image field in [slug].tsx
description:
Currently blog articles only support inline images via standard markdown syntax.

Add support for an optional `image` frontmatter field that renders as a full-width
hero image below the teal title band, before the article body.

## Required changes

1. **`site/blog/*.md` frontmatter** — add optional `image` field to the schema
   documented in `site/blog/.gitkeep`

2. **`site/utils/blog.ts`** — parse the `image` field from frontmatter and expose
   it on the post object

3. **`site/routes/blog/[slug].tsx`** — if `post.image` is set, render a full-width
   hero image block between the teal header section and the article body section.
   Style: full-width, max-height ~400px, object-fit cover, rounded-none (edge-to-edge)
   or rounded-xl with padding — decide at implementation time.

4. **Alt text** — `image_alt` frontmatter field (falls back to post title if absent)

## Notes
- Current task (inline images added to markdown body) is separate and proceeds now
- This feature would supersede or complement inline images depending on article
- Existing articles without `image` field must continue to render unchanged

title: Support wrapping in description of events yaml
description:
Line breaks of `description` in yaml for an event are converted to `
` in the markdown to html rendering. That causes artificial paragraphs in the `events/[eventSlug]` page. The current fix is to ensure there are no line breaks mid-paragraph in the yaml file, but it’s too easy to break that rule. Better solution is to strip line breaks before handing over to markdown renderer. (Or ignore linebreaks setting in renderer if supported.)

title: Blog Topic / Tag Filters
description:
The topic pills on /blog should act as search/filter controls, not just decorative tags.

Requirements

- Clicking a topic pill filters the visible articles to only those tagged with that topic
- Filter should surface both standalone articles AND articles that belong to a series
- When a series contains matching articles, the series card should still appear (or individual matching articles within the series should be shown — TBD with CNG)
- Deselecting/clicking again should clear the filter
- Should work without a full page reload (island / client-side filtering, or query param approach)

Open Questions

- When a series card is shown in filtered view: show the whole series card, or expand to show individual matching articles?
- Single-select (one tag at a time) or multi-select?
- URL-based filter state (e.g. /blog?tag=AI) for shareability?
